label: Windows Event Logs
ta: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Windows (Splunk_TA_windows), XML rendering (renderXml = true)

label: Sysmon (Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational)
ta: Splunk Add-on for Sysmon (needs Splunk_TA_windows for XML parsing)

label: PowerShell Operational channel (4103/4104) - part of Windows Event Logs, listed separately because it needs its own GPO and input
ta: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Windows

label: Windows Firewall text log (pfirewall.log)
ta: Splunk_TA_windows (monitor input on %systemroot%\System32\LogFiles\Firewall\pfirewall.log)

label: Windows Performance counters
ta: Splunk_TA_windows perfmon inputs

label: Windows DNS Server analytical / debug log
ta: Splunk_TA_windows (MSAD:NT6:DNS) or Microsoft-Windows-DNS-Server/Analytical ETW

label: Windows DHCP server log
ta: Splunk_TA_windows

label: IIS access and configuration logs
ta: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft IIS

label: ETW providers not surfaced by Sysmon (Kernel-Process, Win32k, WinINet, RPC, DotNETRuntime, AMSI, Token...)
ta: Requires a user-mode ETW consumer (SilkETW/Sealighter, Splunk Stream for NDIS, or an EDR that exposes the provider). No standard Splunk TA.

label: osquery on Windows
ta: osquery TA (osquery:results)

label: Sysinternals Autoruns scans
ta: TA-autoruns (scripted input)

label: Trellix ePO events (ENS threat/AMSI/adaptive threat protection, ePO audit)
ta: Splunk Add-on for McAfee ePO (mcafee:epo). Verify the sourcetype against your installed TA version.

label: Trellix Application and Change Control (Solidcore) via ePO
ta: Arrives through the ePO TA; Solidcore events carry event names such as FILE_CREATED, FILE_MODIFIED, FILE_DELETED, EXECUTION_DENIED, REG_VALUE_MODIFIED, PROCESS_HIJACK_ATTEMPTED. Verify field names (threat_name / event_description) in your data.

label: EDR raw telemetry (memory, hunting, script block, syscall) - e.g. Trellix EDR, Defender for Endpoint advanced hunting
ta: Vendor specific

label: Corelight / Zeek network logs
ta: Corelight App for Splunk (corelight_<log>). For TA_zeek use prefix zeek: and suffix :json.

label: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS (traffic, threat, URL, system, config, GlobalProtect)
ta: Splunk Add-on for Palo Alto Networks (pan:*)

label: Wireshark / tshark packet captures (ad hoc)
ta: None standard. tshark -T ek output (wireshark:json) or Splunk Stream for continuous capture.

label: Router / switch / non-PAN firewall syslog, config change and AAA logs
ta: Cisco Networks Add-on (cisco:ios, cisco:asa), Juniper/Arista TAs, or generic syslog

label: SNMP traps / polling
ta: Splunk Connect for SNMP

label: NetFlow / IPFIX (non-Zeek flow)
ta: Splunk Stream or Splunk Add-on for NetFlow

label: Linux auditd (SYSCALL/EXECVE/PATH/CONFIG_CHANGE/USER_LOGIN...)
ta: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux (linux:audit) or auditd -> auditbeat/syslog

label: Linux syslog / journald (messages, secure/auth, cron, kernel, daemon)
ta: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux (syslog, linux_secure, linux_messages_syslog)

label: osquery on Linux
ta: osquery TA

label: Sysmon for Linux
ta: Splunk Add-on for Sysmon for Linux

label: iptables / nftables LOG target via kernel syslog
ta: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux (syslog)

label: eBPF runtime security (Falco, Tetragon, Tracee)
ta: Vendor specific (falco JSON, tetragon)

label: Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and audit logs
ta: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Azure (azure:aad:signin, azure:aad:audit) or Microsoft Cloud Services add-on via Event Hub

label: Azure Activity Log (subscription control plane) and Azure Policy
ta: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (mscs:azure:audit)

label: Azure resource diagnostic logs (NSG flow, VM guest, Key Vault, Storage)
ta: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (mscs:azure:eventhub)

label: Microsoft Defender XDR / Defender for Identity alerts and Graph API logs
ta: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Security

label: Kubernetes API server audit log and cluster events
ta: Splunk OpenTelemetry Collector for Kubernetes / Splunk Connect for Kubernetes

label: Docker / containerd daemon and runtime events
ta: docker events scripted input or OpenTelemetry (docker:events, containerd)

label: ESXi host logs via remote syslog (hostd, vmkernel, shell, vobd, vpxa, auth, esxupdate)
ta: Splunk Add-on for VMware ESXi Logs (vmware:esxlog:<log>)

label: vCenter vpxd logs and events
ta: Splunk Add-on for VMware (vmware:vclog:vpxd)

label: macOS unified log / Endpoint Security / osquery / FSEvents
ta: Jamf Protect, Splunk UF with log stream, osquery TA; no single standard TA

label: Microsoft 365 unified audit log (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Purview)
ta: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Office 365 (o365:management:activity)

label: AWS CloudTrail / VPC Flow / CloudWatch / Bedrock
ta: Splunk Add-on for AWS

label: Google Cloud audit / VPC flow / Workspace admin
ta: Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform

label: Okta System Log
ta: Splunk Add-on for Okta Identity Cloud

label: SaaS application audit logs (GitHub, Slack, Salesforce, Zoom, Box, Confluence, Google Workspace...)
ta: Per application

label: Mobile EDR / MDM telemetry
ta: n/a (Mobile ATT&CK domain)

label: OT / ICS application and protocol logs
ta: n/a (ICS ATT&CK domain)

label: External reconnaissance sources (internet scan data, domain registration, malware repositories, persona monitoring)
ta: Threat-intel feeds, not log sources

label: ATT&CK left the provider generic (e.g. "Process", "File", "Network Traffic")
ta: n/a
